card.text: Distant, reddish dwarf planet with one small moon.

introduction.text: Makemake takes about 305 years to orbit the Sun, far beyond Neptune.

color.title: Whole-disc colour and albedo
color.summary: Makemake's measured average colour and brightness, spread evenly. The surface is unresolved: no terrain or markings.

illustration.title: NASA artist's texture
illustration.summary: NASA's illustrated surface from its 3D model. None of it was observed, and its longitudes are arbitrary.
